one: Autonomous robots I: perception, localization, SLAM, nonlinear control, motion planning, and POMDPs.
pos: CS 237A (AA 274A/EE 260A/ME 274A) is taught by Marco Pavone and is the core course on robot autonomy. It connects perception, localization, control, planning, and decision-making under uncertainty, with extensive hands-on ROS work.
topics: **Localization and SLAM**: EKF, particle filters, graph optimization
**Motion planning**: graph search, sampling-based planning, trajectory optimization
**Project**: make a robot complete a task autonomously
assess: Assignments plus a ROS project. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Robotics, autonomous driving, drones, and embodied AI.
tips: Take CS 223A first or have rigid-body kinematics basics. Get familiar with ROS early.
